sunoData.title: Caravan Ashes
sunoData.tags: Ambient game soundtrack with slow evolving desert textures, pulse-like hand percussion, and distant modal drones; verse-like layers open with dry frame hits and sand-choked synth pads, then a midsection adds cracked hand drum patterns and fragile reed tones, and a final section widens into airy overtones and low sub pulses for endless traversal. Ear candy includes wind-riser swells, granular shimmer dust, and occasional stone-chime accents between phrases. Mix is wide, cinematic, and heat-hazed, with intimate foreground detail., ambient
